svg.title: Open source construction tools, by category
svg.desc: 105 open source projects across 13 categories, each checked against the GitHub API: BIM and IFC 22, CAD and drawing 11, Documents and records 6, Scheduling and planning 5, Field data collection 3, Reality capture and survey 12, GIS and site 6, Structural and analysis 6, Energy, MEP and sustainability 9, Machine learning and datasets 5, Cost accounting and ERP 7, Collaboration and PM 6, Automation, robotics and fabrication 7

svg.text: for construction, each with an honest caveat. Licence, language and last commit read from the GitHub API.
